cohort: The study participants were pregnant women with insulin-dependent diabetes mellitus, whose fetuses were divided into two groups based on normal or adverse pregnancy outcomes.
finding: UA S/D ratios serve as ultrasonographical parameters for predicting normal pregnancy outcomes at 28th, 32nd, and 36th weeks of gestation, with specific cutoff values and negative predictive values.
cross-section timing: Measurements taken at 28th, 32nd, and 36th weeks of gestation
gest_age: Measurements taken at 28th, 32nd, and 36th weeks of gestation
